games.name: Suds & Duds Laundromat
games.description: Run the corner laundromat! Click the sorting table to wash loads, then step on glowing pads to buy washers, dryers, a vending machine and more. Knock down the wall to expand into the Dry-Cleaning Wing and light up the Grand Reopening sign. A cozy tycoon by gooberr478.
games.creator: gooberr478
